name: 旋转冲刺
description: 选择正方向冲刺最多5格，对路径首个敌人造成1.5倍伤害并停在其前方。动能5：最多7格。动能7：沉默[1]目标。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,b=context.battle;var core=(c.statusTags||[]).find(function(t){return t.type==='momentum-core';});var momentum=core?Number(core.stacks||0):Number(c.momentum||0);var maxDistance=momentum>=5?7:5;var pos=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:maxDistance,filter:'all'});if(!pos||pos.needsTargetSelection)return pos;var dx=Math.sign(pos.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(pos.y-c.y);if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0))return{success:false,message:'请选择上下左右方向'};var firstEnemy=null,stopStep=0,stopX=c.x,stopY=c.y;for(var i=1;i<=maxDistance;i++){var cx=c.x+dx*i,cy=c.y+dy*i;var tile=b.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===cx&&t.y===cy;});if(!tile||!tile.props.walkable||(tile.props.type!=='floor'&&tile.props.type!=='cover'))break;var enemy=b.pieces.find(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===cx&&p.y===cy&&!arePlayersAllied(b,p.ownerPlayerId,c.ownerPlayerId);});if(enemy){firstEnemy=enemy;stopStep=i-1;stopX=c.x+dx*stopStep;stopY=c.y+dy*stopStep;break;}var occupied=b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===cx&&p.y===cy;});if(!occupied){stopStep=i;stopX=cx;stopY=cy;}}if(stopStep>0){var mv=flow.effects.displace([{pieceId:c.instanceId,x:stopX,y:stopY}],'dash',{passAllies:true,passEnemies:true,terrain:'any'});if(!mv.success)return{success:false,message:'位移被阻挡'};}var msg='';if(firstEnemy){var r=dealDamage(c,firstEnemy,Math.floor(c.attack*1.5),'physical',b,context.skill.id);msg='命中'+firstEnemy.name+'(-'+(r.damage||0)+')';if(momentum>=7&&firstEnemy.currentHp>0){addStatusEffectById(firstEnemy.instanceId,{id:'sonic-silence-'+firstEnemy.instanceId,type:'silenced',name:'沉默',stacks:1,currentDuration:1,relatedRules:['rule-silenced-block']});addRuleById(firstEnemy.instanceId,'rule-silenced-block');}}var preserved=(c.statusTags||[]).some(function(t){return t.type==='preserve-momentum';});var nextMomentum=(preserved?momentum:0)+stopStep;if(core)core.stacks=nextMomentum;c.momentum=nextMomentum;return{success:true,message:(stopStep>0?'冲刺'+stopStep+'格':'未移动')+(msg?'，'+msg:'')};}
